title: CTRES v1.1 R14 Venue Count
description: What the floor counted (§4.14): one row per venue, unit and gaming day, or per period where the profile permits. A unit is a slot machine, whose row carries the meter readings at the start and the end, or the drop where no meter exists; a table or a counter, whose row carries inventories, fills, credits and drop; or the venue total, whose row carries the count-room totals against the units. Venue rows feed the venue line of R13 and reconcile the drop to the cash float in R1 and the banking movement in R6 (§4.13; §4.1; §4.6).

venue_id.description: Identifier of the venue, as carried by venue_id on the venue's R1 cash_float location (§4.14; §4.1).

gaming_day.x-ctres-condition: Unless the profile permits a count per period, given as period_start and period_end; a row carries either gaming_day or the period, never both (§4.14; §5 Revenue and levy).

period_start.x-ctres-condition: Where the profile permits a count per period rather than per gaming day; not used with gaming_day (§4.14; §5 Revenue and levy).

period_end.x-ctres-condition: Where the profile permits a count per period rather than per gaming day; not used with gaming_day (§4.14; §5 Revenue and levy).

unit_type.description: Kind of unit: a slot machine, a gaming table, a counter or cash desk, or the venue total (§4.14).

unit_id.description: Identifier of the unit: the machine or table number, the counter, or the venue itself on a venue_total row (§4.14).

currency.description: Currency in which the amounts of the row are stated (§4.14; §3 Currency-aware).

meter_source.description: How the readings of the row were taken: electronic, from a monitoring or casino management system; manual_read, from a manual meter reading or from opener and closer slips; or not_recorded where the source left no record (§4.14; §3 Visible gaps).

meters_start.description: Meter readings at the start of the gaming day or period (§4.14).
meters_start.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is slot_machine, unless meter_source is not_recorded; not used on other rows (§4.14; §3 Visible gaps).

meters_end.description: Meter readings at the end of the gaming day or period (§4.14).
meters_end.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is slot_machine, unless meter_source is not_recorded; not used on other rows (§4.14; §3 Visible gaps).

opening_inventory.description: Chips and cash at the unit at the start, from the opener (§4.14).
opening_inventory.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is table or counter (§4.14).

closing_inventory.description: Chips and cash at the unit at the end, from the closer (§4.14).
closing_inventory.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is table or counter (§4.14).

fills.description: Chips brought to the unit from the cage (§4.14).
fills.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is table; on counter rows where fills apply; and on slot_machine rows where win_formula is slot_drop_formula (drop, less fills and hand-paid jackpots) (§4.14).

credits.description: Chips returned from the unit to the cage (§4.14).
credits.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is table; on counter rows where credits apply (§4.14).

drop_cash.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is table; on counter rows where a drop applies; on slot_machine rows where win_formula is slot_drop_formula (§4.14).

drop_markers.description: Markers and other credit instruments in the drop box (§4.14).
drop_markers.x-ctres-condition: Table and counter rows where markers or credit are extended (§4.14; §5 Revenue and levy notes chargebacks_and_bad_debts).

coupons_face_value.description: Face value of coupons and promotional chips in the drop box (§4.14).
coupons_face_value.x-ctres-condition: Table and counter rows where coupons or promotional chips go through the drop and the profile counts their face value (§4.14; §5 Revenue and levy notes land_based).

hard_count.description: Count-room total of coin and tokens (§4.14).
hard_count.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is venue_total; not used on other rows (§4.14).

soft_count.description: Count-room total of notes, tickets and vouchers (§4.14).
soft_count.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is venue_total; not used on other rows (§4.14).

count_variance.description: Count-room totals less the drop the units' meters and drop boxes state, stated rather than hidden (§4.14; §4.7).
count_variance.x-ctres-condition: Mandatory where unit_type is venue_total; not used on other rows (§4.14).

tips_excluded.description: Tips and gratuities taken out of the drop before the win is computed (§4.14; §5 Revenue and levy notes land_based).

win_declared.description: The unit's win for the day or period; negative where the unit lost (§4.14).

win_formula.description: Formula applied: table_drop_formula (closing inventory plus credits plus drop, less opening inventory and fills), slot_meter_formula (metered in, less metered out, hand-paid jackpots, cancelled credits and progressive payouts), slot_drop_formula (drop, less fills and hand-paid jackpots), or profile (the formula the profile defines). A table row names table_drop_formula or profile; a slot_machine row names slot_meter_formula, slot_drop_formula or profile; a counter or venue_total row names any of the four (§4.14; §5 Revenue and levy levy_formula venue_win_formulas).

drop_deposit_ref.description: The R6 movement or the R1 cash_float location the drop was banked to (§4.14; §4.6; §4.1).

prepared_by.description: Who prepared the count, as in R7 (§4.14; §4.7).

reviewed_by.description: Who reviewed the count, as in R7 (§4.14; §4.7).

slot_meters.description: The meter set of a slot machine, the GLI-11 §3.9.7 set, read at the start and at the end of the gaming day or period (§4.14). Money meters are cumulative amounts in the currency of the row; games_played is a cumulative count. A meter the machine does not have is omitted.

coin_out.description: Total amount paid out by the machine, excluding hand-paid jackpots (§4.14).

cancelled_credits.description: Credits cancelled and paid by hand (§4.14).

progressive_payouts_machine_paid.description: Progressive jackpot payouts paid by the machine (§4.14; GLI-11 §3.9.7).

progressive_payouts_attendant_paid.description: Progressive jackpot payouts paid by an attendant (§4.14; GLI-11 §3.9.7).

wat_in.description: Cashless (wagering-account) transfers in to the machine (§4.14; GLI-11 §3.9.7).

wat_out.description: Cashless (wagering-account) transfers out of the machine (§4.14; GLI-11 §3.9.7).
